name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
description: A simple and flavorful sweet and sour chicken recipe using onion soup mix and apricot jam.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together onion soup mix, apricot jam, and Russian dressing in a bowl.
Pour the mixture over the chicken in a baking dish.
Bake at 350°F for 2 hours.

keywords: sweet and sour chicken, easy chicken recipe, apricot jam chicken

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Chicken Celebrity
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a ketchup-based sauce, perfect for baking.

recipeInstructions.text: Arrange chicken parts in a small roaster or casserole.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Spoon over chicken, covering all pieces.
Bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour or until tender.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, sweet and savory, ketchup-based sauce

_similar.name: Chicken with a Chinese Accent
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a Chinese-inspired flavor profile, featuring soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry chicken breasts in a frying pan with oil and soya sauce until the outsides are done.
Transfer the chicken to a casserole dish.
Mix the remaining ingredients with soya sauce and pour over the chicken.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°F.
Serve the chicken with rice.

_similar.keywords: Chinese chicken, sweet and savory, baked chicken

_similar.name: Creamy Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and comforting broccoli soup made with potatoes, chicken broth, and a touch of Miracle Whip for richness.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add potatoes and broccoli. Simmer for 10 minutes or until tender.
Purée the mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the puréed mixture back into the saucepan. Using a whisk, blend in Miracle Whip and seasonings.
Heat the soup thoroughly, stirring occasionally, until warmed through. Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: creamy broccoli soup, potato soup, comforting soup

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.
